title.vi: Lược đồ sao và kho dữ liệu phân tích
title.en: Star schemas and analytic data warehouses

summary.vi: bảng sự kiện (fact), bảng chiều (dimension), hạt (grain), truy vấn trên lược đồ sao
summary.en: fact tables, dimension tables, grain, querying a star schema

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
-- Lược đồ sao thu nhỏ từ dữ liệu cửa hàng
CREATE VIEW fact_sales AS
SELECT oi.id AS line_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, oi.product_id,
       oi.quantity, oi.quantity * p.price AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o   ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed';

-- Truy vấn kiểu BI: doanh thu theo loại sản phẩm và thành phố khách
SELECT p.category, c.city, SUM(f.revenue) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN products  p ON p.id = f.product_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = f.customer_id
GROUP BY p.category, c.city
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

prompt.vi: Dựng sẵn fact_sales ở dưới. Trả về doanh thu theo THÁNG (month dạng YYYY-MM, revenue) từ các đơn 'completed', sắp xếp theo month. Gợi ý: strftime trên order_date.
prompt.en: fact_sales is built below. Return revenue per MONTH (month as YYYY-MM, revenue) from 'completed' orders, sorted by month. Hint: strftime on order_date.

hint.vi: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) FROM fact_sales GROUP BY month.
hint.en: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) FROM fact_sales GROUP BY month.

CREATE VIEW fact_sales AS
SELECT oi.id AS line_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, oi.product_id,
       oi.quantity, oi.quantity * p.price AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o   ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed';

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

CREATE VIEW fact_sales AS
SELECT oi.id AS line_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, oi.product_id,
       oi.quantity, oi.quantity * p.price AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o   ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed';

SELECT p.category, SUM(f.revenue) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN products p ON p.id = f.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category;
